description:
Terracotta Jali Tiles 017 build a curved jali boundary wall: the product photo shows a sweeping boundary wall made of rectangular hollow terracotta jali blocks, suited to garden edges, corner plots and driveways where a straight wall would feel heavy.

## How it looks
The blocks are rectangular with hollow openings, laid course by course so the wall follows a curve. The curve and the open cells together make a long wall look lighter, and the clay colour gives a warm edge to a lawn or a road. Up close, each block shows its hollow face; from a distance the wall reads as an even pattern.

## Where it works
- **Garden boundary wall design** around a lawn or a farmhouse plot.
- **Hollow terracotta jali blocks** at a corner plot, where a curved wall softens the turn.
- **Rectangular clay jali block** walls along a driveway or parking edge, letting air through.

A jali boundary lets breeze pass, which tends to keep wind load lower than on a solid wall and keeps gardens airy in summer.

## Good to know
- Category: terracotta jali
- Design: rectangular hollow jali blocks laid in a curved boundary wall (from the product photo)
- Block size, colour and thickness are not listed online yet; confirm them before you order.

A curved wall needs a set-out line and a proper footing; ask your mason to add piers or reinforcement at intervals. Brush dust out of the openings and wash with plain water.

## See it before you order
Visit the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) or G-04 Civic Center, Executive Block, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm, or ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715) with your wall length for a dated quote. Read the [terracotta jali guide](/blog/terracotta-jali-in-pakistan-designs-uses-and-ordering-guide) or browse the full [terracotta jali range](/categories/terracotta-jali).

faqs.q: What is the price of a curved jali boundary wall?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the wall length and height, the number of blocks and delivery to your city, so send your measurements on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) for a dated written quote.

faqs.q: Can jali blocks be laid in a curve?
faqs.a: Yes. Rectangular blocks can follow a gentle curve when the wall is set out on a marked line; tight curves need more cutting, so discuss the radius with your mason.

faqs.q: Jali boundary wall or solid brick wall: which is better?
faqs.a: A solid wall gives full privacy and security; a jali wall gives airflow, light and a lighter look, and is often combined with solid sections or a solid base.

faqs.q: Can I see a sample before ordering?
faqs.a: Yes. Message Pak Clay on WhatsApp at +92 300 4617715 with "Terracotta Jali Tiles 017" and your city, or visit the Lahore showroom on Walton Road or the Islamabad location at G-04 Civic Center, Gulberg Greens, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm.
